svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: BNO08x: UART-RVC
svg.desc: Schematic of the BNO08x uart-rvc: the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor 100 nF, C2 capacitor 100 nF, C3 capacitor 100 nF, R3 resistor 10 kΩ, R4 resistor 4.7 kΩ, R5 resistor 4.7 kΩ, Y1 crystal 32.768 kHz; the MCU wires carry the port hooks SetBootn(), SetReset(), SetWake(), transport hooks.
svg.text: The BNO08x streaming its 19-byte frames at 115200 baud (PS1 low, PS0 high). Only the chip's transmit line is needed; the 32.768 kHz crystal is
required. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 1.2.5 UART-RVC interface, p. 20.
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R4 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the environmental bus; R5 4.7 kΩ: the data sheet gives no value for the environmental bus.
